review_type: Internal completeness and improvement audit; not an external peer review or acceptance forecast.
verdict: Structurally complete as a focused review, with material analytical improvements still available before final submission.
main_new_result: Joint domain/length standardization retains a large arithmetic difference and substantially attenuates the tactic-mode and local-claim differences.
strengths: Six source-traced cases with explicit preservation interfaces and explanatory examples.
546 retained source artifacts and 53 manuscript locators rechecked against pinned bytes.
800 survey source blobs and hash-ranked membership reverified; 13,309 OAI and 186,751 Mathlib extracted bodies.
Current bibliography has 44 cited records, no missing or unused citation keys and retained identity checks for 25 published scholarly DOI records.
Three actual upstream TraceCone modules and an importing corollary have retained successful compilation logs.

additional_robustness.interpretation: Directory families and certificate-directory exclusion are rough sensitivity proxies, not semantic project or task matching. Module sampling estimates the specified source-module population; equal family weights answer a different question.

priority_gaps.finding: Headline results use subject-standardized module-balanced rates; length is considered separately using pooled within-band rates. The additional joint analysis changes the magnitude of the style differences substantially.
priority_gaps.evidence: Tactic mode +29.2 -> +10.4 pp; local claims/calculation chains +34.1 -> +5.8 pp; arithmetic/algebra +30.5 -> +22.8 pp.
priority_gaps.action: Integrate joint controls as a third comparison or compact robustness table, revise the abstract and synthesis to foreground the arithmetic difference, and explain that conditioning on length removes part of the proof style being described.
priority_gaps.completion_criterion: Readers can compare raw, subject-only and joint estimates with identical target units and a clear interpretation.

priority_gaps.finding: Lexical features show where devices are written; they do not measure actual executions, solved goals, elaboration cost or semantic proof methods. Forty deliberately stratified manual cases and eleven boundary checks are useful but do not estimate error in unseen bodies.
priority_gaps.action: Trace a manageable, preselected cohort using Lean elaboration; compare syntax/token labels with actual tactic nodes and before/after goals. Add held-out source inspections, including definitions or instances carrying mathematical work.
priority_gaps.completion_criterion: Retained traces for representative compiled bodies and a clear validation denominator; errors or unsupported forms logged rather than inferred absent.

priority_gaps.finding: The retained upstream compilation covers Basic, FiniteIdeal and IdealTransport from TraceCone plus an importing corollary. The other five cases use source analysis.
priority_gaps.action: Compile selected analytical and discrete interface chains, starting with the Crouzeix scalar core and a graph coordinate/counting interface; inspect their reported axioms and the downstream theorem statements.
priority_gaps.completion_criterion: Fresh logs identify exact source bytes, targets, imports, toolchain and axiom dependencies. Separate compilation, statement fidelity and mathematical interpretation.

priority_gaps.finding: Mathlib is an established library baseline, not a matched set of the same formalization tasks. Domain and length controls leave theorem role, abstraction level, project organization and provenance unmatched.
priority_gaps.action: Select a small comparison cohort of analogous human-authored Lean developments and label declaration roles such as certificate leaf, transport bridge, analytic estimate and theorem assembly. Compare roles within comparable tasks.
priority_gaps.completion_criterion: The paper can distinguish broad library composition from a difference in how analogous proof work is organized.

priority_gaps.finding: The review has original descriptive analysis and a useful synthesis. Its case studies use established mathematical and Lean devices; a different frequency does not establish a new tactic or historical priority.
priority_gaps.action: Add a concise prior-art comparison identifying inherited device, project-specific integration and demonstrated formal payoff for each case; make the literature basis explicit for certificate verification and interface design.
priority_gaps.completion_criterion: Every unusualness claim has a concrete comparator and a clear scope.

priority_gaps.finding: The 32-page manuscript now combines a six-case review and an empirical survey. The new synthesis connects them, but the reader must still reconstruct the relationship between local proof goals and the corpus categories.
priority_gaps.action: Use two annotated actual Lean excerpts showing representation or invariant -> local obligation -> closing tactic, with goal states if traced. Keep detailed validation records in the package rather than adding more prose to the main text.
priority_gaps.completion_criterion: A reader can explain the central finding from the overview, one worked source example and the controlled comparison.

primary_sources_consulted.title: Mathlib Library Style Guidelines
primary_sources_consulted.use: Baseline style permits both term and tactic proofs; distinctiveness is relative to the sampled baseline.

primary_sources_consulted.title: Lean.Elab.InfoTree.Types
primary_sources_consulted.use: Elaboration metadata provides tactic and goal-state information beyond lexical tokens; implementation must use the project toolchain.

primary_sources_consulted.title: LeanDojo: Theorem Proving with Retrieval-Augmented Language Models
primary_sources_consulted.use: Primary precedent for extracting proof-environment and premise data; no assertion of compatibility with the current pinned Lean toolchain.

scope: No new full endpoint build, semantic annotation cohort, task-matched outcome experiment or independent expert review was completed in this audit.
